# Feature construction

## Variants

In addition to the original images from the dataset, we also construct a number of *variants* of the images,
which are intended to highlight certain aspects of the images.
These variants are constructed using various image processing techniques,
such as edge detection and gradient computation.

```{r variant-functions, code=unlist(lapply(list.files("R/variants", pattern="\\.R$", full.names=TRUE), readLines)), fold="Variants functions"}
for (file in list.files("R/variants", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) {
  source(file, local = TRUE)
}
```

```{r code=readLines("R/visualization/images.R"), fold="Image plotting function", message=FALSE}
source("R/visualization/images.R", local = TRUE, print.eval = TRUE)
```

```{r show-variants, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
v <- image_variants(as_matrix(x_train[1, ]))

maps <- c(
  list(original = v$regions$full$img),
  v$regions$full$edges,
  v$regions$full$gradients
)

old_par <- par(mfrow = c(2, 4), mar = rep(0, 4))

for (name in names(maps)) {
  map <- maps[[name]]
  as_image(map, nr = nrow(map))
  legend("top", legend = name, bg = "white")
}

par(old_par)
```

## ROIs

We also define a number of *regions of interest* (ROIs) in the images
in order to focus on specific parts of the face, such as the eyes, nose, and mouth.

```{r code=readLines("R/visualization/rois.R"), fold="ROI plotting function", message=FALSE}
source("R/visualization/rois.R", local = TRUE, print.eval = TRUE)
```

```{r}
facial_rois
plot_image_rois(as_matrix(x_train[1, ]), facial_rois)
```

## Features

Now, for relevant combinations of image variants and ROIs,
we can compute a number of *features* that summarize the information in the images.

```{r feature-functions, code=unlist(lapply(list.files("R/features", pattern="\\.R$", full.names=TRUE), readLines)), fold="Feature functions"}
for (file in list.files("R/features", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) {
  source(file, local = TRUE)
}
```

```{r extract-features}
features_train <- features(x_train)
features_test <- features(x_test)
```
